concise, clear, landing naturally as a settled conclusion; not flat, not dramatic.
Speak at a slightly slower, relaxed pace than natural adult narration, while keeping the delivery smooth, conversational, and natural. Do not exaggerate pauses or sound instructional.
asr_text: A study of homes in New Zealand suggests clutter can sometimes help daily life, as one person kept supplements in sight to remember them. Before putting something away, ask what it helps with. The study did not test whether keeping supplements in sight stops people from missing doses.
